html:
SMTO-POL-0005 — Your earlier confirmation no longer covers this action

GUID: e461d0e6-db40-4325-8148-1cd117cf9bd6
Slug: unsafe-authorization-invalid
Domain: POL · Subsystem: pol

What happened

  • The confirmation for this risky action expired, was withdrawn, or no longer matches what's waiting to run, so SMTO didn't run the action.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the confirmation window, select Cancel. An expired or changed confirmation can't be reused, and Cancel stops the Task so nothing runs on the old confirmation.
  2. Check the Task's activity to confirm the action didn't run, then ask the Agent for it again. SMTO stopped before running it, so asking again won't do it twice.
  3. When the new confirmation window appears, check Exact operation and confirm within about five minutes. Confirmations expire after a few minutes, and restarting SMTO or changing the Unsafe actions setting also cancels them.

What success looks like

  • After you confirm, the confirmation window closes and the step runs in the Task's activity.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep resending the old confirmation; it will be refused every time.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Unsafe-action authorization failed at preflight or dispatch-time consumption because the grant expired (5-minute TTL), was revoked by a policy change or Server restart, was already consumed, or no longer matches the exact operation binding; the operation was not dispatched.

What this means

  • Approval validation or dispatch-time consumption found an expired, changed, revoked or mismatched grant. Policy and approval decisions are scoped to their owning operation. Existing receipts determine prior effects; this explanation neither grants authority nor changes retry ownership.

Why this can happen

  • Approval validation or dispatch-time consumption found an expired, changed, revoked or mismatched grant.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the current operation binding and challenge with the saved grant, including changes after approval but before dispatch.

How to fix it

  • Cancel the stale challenge and let the run raise a fresh unsafe-action challenge for the exact current operation, then confirm it before its expires_at. Do not reuse a stale challenge_id or grant; grants live only in the Server process (UnsafeAuthority, TTL 300 s) and are revoked by unsafe_action_policy changes.
  • Review a fresh challenge for the exact current operation; do not reuse stale approval.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The exact current operation has a valid unconsumed grant when dispatch checks it.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Policy and approval decisions are scoped to their owning operation. Existing receipts determine prior effects; this explanation neither grants authority nor changes retry ownership.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
